A complete document treated as operational capability.

positive_controls.argument: Signal origin, item units, freshness and decision authority supply behavioral semantics that both sides of the interface must agree on.
A trustworthy signal plus explicit forecast complement can inform the next commitment without pretending that current withdrawals reveal future long-lead need.
Checking origin, units, freshness and exception treatment prevents a distorted signal from silently becoming the forecast baseline.
A shared demand-information contract clarifies which signal authorizes what replenishment and when forecasts or exceptions must supplement it.
Reliable startup demand and supply signals inform stock, staffing and replenishment preparation for the actual transition.
Valid demand and replenishment information identifies what restoration capacity or replacement stock is needed and can expose a looming shortfall.
Current signal semantics and long-lead visibility inform spares and support scheduling and distinguish normal consumption from obsolescence or exceptional failure demand.
Signal fidelity and latency supply an observability and exposure premise for control selection; trustworthy information may confirm an existing choice without changing action.
